description: Six independent pairs of full-policy replacements, written before model responses. Alice writes English and Bob Spanish. These are evaluator fixtures, not model answers. Send only baseline and each case input to a responder; never send expected fields or operator titles.

domain.resident: whether the applicant lives in the named neighborhood
domain.eligibility: join combines the age and residency eligibility conditions; the deadline is always ANDed with the combined eligibility result
domain.unsupported: If the whole draft cannot be faithfully expressed in the available rule fields, expected rules and all draft outcomes are null. Request clarification instead of inventing a rule or silently dropping a clause.
domain.deadline: Drafts replace the complete policy. A missing timezone must not inherit UTC from the baseline. Age thresholds refer to completed whole years. Inclusive means submittedAt <= deadline; exclusive means submittedAt < deadline.

baseline.en: Applicants must be at least 16 years old and live in the neighborhood. Applications must be received no later than 5 November 2026 at 18:00 UTC; a submission exactly at that instant is accepted.
baseline.es: Las personas solicitantes deben tener al menos 16 años y vivir en el barrio. Las solicitudes deben recibirse a más tardar el 5 de noviembre de 2026 a las 18:00 UTC; se acepta una solicitud recibida exactamente en ese instante.

cases.title: Fresh threshold and date with AND versus OR

drafts.alice: Applicants qualify if they are at least 18 years old or live in the neighborhood; meeting either condition is enough. Applications must be received by 12 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC, including a submission exactly at 17:00.
drafts.bob: Para participar, hay que tener al menos 18 años y vivir en el barrio; es obligatorio cumplir las dos condiciones. Las solicitudes deben recibirse a más tardar el 12 de noviembre de 2026 a las 17:00 UTC, incluida una solicitud recibida exactamente a esa hora.

drafts.alice: Participation is limited to neighborhood residents who have reached their sixteenth birthday. Send the application no later than 18:00 UTC on 5 November 2026. Applications arriving exactly at the deadline count as on time.
drafts.bob: Pueden participar quienes viven en el barrio y tienen 16 años cumplidos o más. El último instante para recibir la solicitud es el 5 de noviembre de 2026 a las 18:00 UTC; ese instante está incluido.

drafts.alice: Applicants must be older than 20 years, counting completed whole years, and must live in the neighborhood. The application must arrive strictly before 09:00 UTC on 9 November 2026; an application arriving exactly at 09:00 is too late.
drafts.bob: Las personas solicitantes deben tener al menos 20 años cumplidos y vivir en el barrio. La solicitud debe llegar como máximo el 9 de noviembre de 2026 a las 09:00 UTC; se admite una llegada exactamente a esa hora.

drafts.alice: You cannot participate if you are under 18 years old or do not live in the neighborhood. Everyone else is eligible, provided their application is received by 5 November 2026 at 18:00 UTC, with that exact instant included.
drafts.bob: Quedan excluidas únicamente las personas que sean menores de 18 años y que, además, no vivan en el barrio. Las demás pueden participar siempre que la solicitud se reciba a más tardar el 5 de noviembre de 2026 a las 18:00 UTC, incluido ese instante.

cases.title: Guarantor exception exceeds the supported model

alice.unresolvedReason: Guarantor status is a required additional variable absent from the five rule fields. Do not erase the exception, set residency optional for every nonresident, or invent guarantor information.

drafts.alice: Applicants must be at least 16 years old and live in the neighborhood. A nonresident aged 16 or older may also participate if a neighborhood resident signs as their guarantor. Applications must be received by 5 November 2026 at 18:00 UTC, including that exact instant.
drafts.bob: Para participar, es necesario tener al menos 16 años y vivir en el barrio. Las solicitudes deben recibirse a más tardar el 5 de noviembre de 2026 a las 18:00 UTC; una solicitud recibida exactamente entonces es válida.

cases.title: Explicit calendar date with an unspecified local timezone

alice.unresolvedReason: Local time has no specified timezone or location. Do not assume UTC, a browser timezone, or the baseline timezone; ask which timezone applies.

drafts.alice: Applicants must be at least 19 years old and live in the neighborhood. Applications close on 13 November 2026 at 18:00 local time, with the closing instant included. The event location and the timezone used for this local deadline have not been specified.
drafts.bob: Las personas solicitantes deben tener al menos 19 años y vivir en el barrio. La inscripción cierra el 13 de noviembre de 2026 a las 18:00 UTC; se acepta una solicitud recibida exactamente en ese instante.
